name: Search API AZ Glossary
description: Creates a glossary fields (A B C ...) based on node titles and user names
project_description:

 Drupal 8 branch 
 This is a complete rewrite of the old D7 module. It is shiny and packed full of new features.

 Release tag 8.3 tested with: 
 
 Drupal 8.3 
 Search API 8.1.1 
 Facets Alpha 9 
 If upgrading from previous version, it is advised to re-install 
 
 Release tag 8.3.3 tested with 
 
 Drupal 8.3 & 8.4 
 Search API 8.1.5 
 Facets Beta 1 
 If upgrading from previous version, it is advised to re-install 
 
 D8 Version Documentation : 

 To open up collaboration and ease of contribution, the project is also available on https://github.com/dakkusingh/drupalglossaryazsearch 

 New features in D8 Branch: 

 
 Add a Glossary AZ index to an Entity type or Bundle 
 Works for nodes, users, comments, basically almost everything 
 Multiple backends supported, you can choose Drupal DB search, Solr Search, ElasticSearch 
 Works with Views, Search API, Search API Page, Facets module 
 Drupal 8 Native Plugin architecture 
 Facets Plugin Architecture 
 Facet filters and sorting support 
 Facet theme support 
 Multiple Facets 
 
 Back to top 

 Drupal 7 Branch 
 Provides A-Z Glossary facet for Apache Solr Searches, using Search API and Apache Solr and Facet API.

 Features in D7 Branch 

 
 Add a Glossary AZ to a single field 
 Apache Solr support only 
 Search API support only 
 Supports only 1 facet 
 
 Drupal 7 version of the module is for use with Search API Solr module. If you are using ApacheSolr, use my other module called Apache Solr Glossary Facet .
